output.objection: You are looking at the wrong metric if you only count the minutes saved on the hand over. I want the evaluation harness to flag when a new model hurts availability on the middle aisle before it ever reaches a store.
output.correction: I am not asking for a faster pipeline, I am asking for a stricter gate on the model quality. The cycle time is only important if the result actually reduces our residual stock and waste.
